rules.text: When a claim involves possible business use of a personal auto policy (delivery, rideshare, or any paid transport), never deny or fast-track. Route to coverage review with human sign-off.

rules.text: When a claim involves possible business use of a personal auto policy (delivery, rideshare, or any paid transport), never deny or fast-track. Route to coverage review with human sign-off.
When a policy cancellation or driver exclusion may be invalid due to missing notice or missing signature, do not deny or pay. Route to coverage review with human sign-off.
When a claim is reported more than 30 days after the loss, do not deny or pay. Route to coverage review with human sign-off before any payment decision.

When a claim is not at fault and subrogation is pursued, do not apply the insured's deductible. The deductible must be included in the subrogation demand and refunded to the insured from the recovery.
When a claim involves no injuries and clear liability, route to fast-track. Do not route to subrogation unless the insured is not at fault.

When a claim involves a rear-end collision where the lead vehicle braked suddenly with no apparent reason and multiple occupants report similar injuries treated at the same clinic, refer to SIU as a suspected staged accident. Do not concede 100% fault without SIU review.

claims.description: Our insured rear-ended a sedan stopped at a red light at about 15 mph; no injuries and a police report was filed. Policy is active with collision coverage and a $500 deductible.
claims.expected: Covered. Pay the other car under property-damage liability and our insured's car under collision minus the $500 deductible. Insured 100% at fault (CA presumes the following driver negligent). Route: fast-track.

claims.description: The insured's car rear-ended a pickup at a stop sign while being driven by the insured's nephew. The nephew is listed on the policy as an excluded driver, and the exclusion was signed by the named insured.
claims.expected: Deny both the liability and collision claims. The TX named-driver exclusion is valid because the named insured signed it. Send the excluded-driver letter. Route: human sign-off on the denial.

claims.description: Our insured rear-ended a hatchback after it braked hard for no apparent reason; the hatchback had 4 occupants. Days later all 4 reported neck pain and are being treated at the same clinic.
claims.expected: Covered, but refer to SIU as a suspected staged swoop-and-squat. TX has no automatic rear-driver fault presumption, so do not concede 100% fault; the sudden braking supports a comparative-fault argument. Report suspected fraud to the TX Dept of Insurance. Injury claim, so route to an adjuster, never fast-track.

claims.description: Our insured was stopped in traffic when another driver rear-ended them; the other driver admitted fault in the police report. Policy is active with collision coverage and a $500 deductible.
claims.expected: Not at fault. Pay our insured's collision claim now and pursue subrogation against the other carrier. CA requires the $500 deductible to be included in the subrogation demand and refunded to the insured from the recovery. Route: subrogation.

claims.description: Our insured rear-ended a minivan in a parking lot exit at low speed with no injuries. The policy was cancelled for non-payment 12 days before the crash, and the grace period is 10 days.
claims.expected: Deny: no coverage was in force on the date of loss, but only after confirming the CA-required 10-day notice of cancellation was mailed to the insured. If notice was not mailed, the policy is still in force: route to coverage review. Route: human sign-off on the denial.
